description: MainActivity.kt defines the MainActivity class which hosts a WebView for a TV-optimized Android application. It loads a local HTML page as the Home screen, configures WebView settings for asset loading and remote control interaction, and manages navigation and key events specific to TV remote control.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: A FragmentActivity subclass that hosts a WebView optimized for Android TV, loading a local home page and handling remote control navigation.

methods.name: loadHome
methods.description: Reloads the local HTML file serving as the app's home page inside the WebView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the WebView with appropriate settings, and loads the home page.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles remote control key events, mapping D-pad center and Enter keys to trigger click events within the WebView, and back navigation.
